name: Roseto degli Abruzzi (Italy)
description: White field with a light blue border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Roseto degli Abruzzi (mountains above the sea on light blue) within branches, with the inscription CITTÀ DI above and ROSETO DEGLI ABRUZZI below in yellow.
history: Municipal flag of Roseto degli Abruzzi, a comune in Abruzzo; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Roseto degli Abruzzi arms — mountains above the sea, crowned, within branches
inscription CITTÀ DI above and ROSETO DEGLI ABRUZZI below the arms
